privacy.title: Privacy policy
body: QR-Universe (“we”) provides digital catalogs accessed by QR code. This policy explains what we collect and why.
Account data: name, email, hashed password, company profile (logo, address, phone, catalog content) that you submit.
Usage data: QR scan events (time, locale, device type), catalog views, and an anonymous visitor id used only to count people currently online.
We do not sell personal data. We do not use advertising trackers.
Session cookies keep you signed in. Preference cookies remember language, theme, and cookie consent.
You may access, correct, or delete your workspace from Settings. Deleting a workspace removes the company catalog, QR codes, and the owner account.
To exercise privacy rights or ask questions, call +90 541 323 00 02 (WhatsApp available).
We retain catalog and scan data while your account is active, then delete it when you delete the workspace.

terms.title: Terms of service
body: By creating an account you agree to these terms.
You own the content you upload. You grant us a license to host and display it on your public catalog URL.
Do not upload illegal, infringing, or harmful content. We may suspend workspaces that violate the law or these terms.
The Free, Pro, and Enterprise plans describe current feature limits. Prices shown on the site may change with notice.
The service is provided as-is. We are not liable for lost sales from QR downtime or customer devices.
You may delete your workspace at any time from Settings.

cookies.title: Cookie policy
body: We use essential cookies for login (session) and to store your language, theme, and cookie-consent choice.
A short-lived anonymous id counts how many visitors are online. It is not used for advertising.
You can clear cookies in your browser. Blocking the session cookie will sign you out of the admin dashboard.

banner.text: We use essential cookies for login, language, theme, and a live visitor count. No ads.
